connector.name: Vault Cortex
connector.registryDescription: Standalone MCP server for Obsidian vaults - hybrid search, notes & files, memory, tasks, OAuth 2.1
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image vault-cortex:0.33.6. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the aliasunder account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token for MCP client authentication. Must match the Authorization header sent by clients. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

env.name: PUBLIC_URL
env.description: Public URL clients use to reach this server. Used as the OAuth issuer URL in discovery metadata. Override when exposing the server outside localhost or on a non-default port.

env.name: EMBEDDING_ENABLED
env.description: Enable or disable the embedding pipeline. When false, no ONNX model is downloaded, no vector tables are created, and search uses FTS5 only.

env.name: RERANK_MODE
env.description: Cross-encoder reranking mode: blended (position-aware score blending after RRF fusion) or none (skip reranking). Only takes effect when EMBEDDING_ENABLED is true.

env.name: WINDOWS_MODE
env.description: Windows bind-mount mode: enables filesystem polling for the file watcher and rename-based moves across the Docker Desktop/WSL2 bridge. Set to true when the vault lives on a Windows drive.

env.name: MEMORY_ENABLED
env.description: Enable or disable the structured memory layer. When false, memory tools are hidden, bootstrap is skipped, and server metadata omits memory references.

env.name: FILE_TOOLS_ENABLED
env.description: Enable or disable file tools (vault_read_file, vault_list_files). When false, file tools are hidden and server metadata omits file tool references.

env.name: MEMORY_DIR
env.description: Vault folder for structured memory files (About Me-style notes). Memory tools are hidden when MEMORY_ENABLED is false, but this value still feeds the defaults for PROTECTED_PATHS and ORPHAN_EXCLUDE_FOLDERS.

env.name: TZ
env.description: IANA timezone for timestamps and daily note resolution.

env.name: LOG_DIR
env.description: Directory for persistent log files. Unset by default — logs go to stdout only. Set to /data/logs to also write date-stamped .log files to the persistent volume.

env.name: LOG_RETENTION_DAYS
env.description: Days to retain persistent log files before cleanup.

env.name: PROTECTED_PATHS
env.description: Comma-separated vault folder names blocked from vault_delete_note. Default: MEMORY_DIR and "Daily Notes".

env.name: ORPHAN_EXCLUDE_FOLDERS
env.description: Comma-separated vault folder names excluded from vault_find_orphans. Default: "Daily Notes", "Templates", MEMORY_DIR.

env.name: SERVICE_DOCUMENTATION_URL
env.description: Override the OAuth service documentation URL exposed via discovery metadata.

env.name: MAX_FILE_BYTES
env.description: Largest file vault_read_file will read, in bytes. Reading a larger file returns an error instead of content.

env.name: MAX_IMAGE_OUTPUT_BYTES
env.description: Byte budget for images returned by vault_read_file, in binary bytes before base64 encoding. Images exceeding the budget are downscaled/recompressed server-side to fit; raise for clients that accept larger tool responses.

env.name: MAX_PDF_RENDER_PAGES
env.description: Maximum PDF pages to render as images when raw: true is set on vault_read_file. The per-page byte budget is MAX_IMAGE_OUTPUT_BYTES divided evenly across the rendered pages.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token used by the MCP client. Must match the MCP_AUTH_TOKEN env var passed to the container.
